id: title:eli-r-ph:drop sweep partitions on a leader replica

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the ClickHouse workload selection and host availability checks for partition dropping, potentially improving reliability and compatibility with ClickHouse's workload-aware scheduling.
review.reason: Adds a dependency on the ClickHouse workload module and explicitly selects online hosts for partition dropping, which could prevent failures on maintenance or offline nodes.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the broader context of how this workload selection is used and whether the downstream consumers rely on this distinction; no test or release notes are provided to verify the outcome.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are supplied; no other hunks are available. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds import of Workload from posthog.clickhouse.workload.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the Workload enum used downstream to distinguish workload types, potentially supporting routing or compatibility checks.

observations.behavior: Adds parameter Workload.ONLINE to cluster.any_host_by_role call, while retaining NodeRole.DATA.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the host selection for dropping run partitions to prefer online replicas, possibly avoiding failures on maintenance or offline nodes.
